command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-visible-single-v5.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-eye-scheduler-attribution-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
DIR="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity"
HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH_HEAD=$HEAD
python3 -m py_compile "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_single_v5.py"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
PROD_BEFORE=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRODUCTION_CHROME_BEFORE=$PROD_BEFORE
for spec in 'normal_blink:9340:9341' 'special_raw:9350:9351' 'special_predecoded:9360:9361'; do
  IFS=: read -r MODE HTTP CDP <<<"$spec"
  OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_scheduler_visible_single_v5_${MODE}_20260912_0951"
  echo "=== MODE=$MODE ==="
  GO_EYE_MODE="$MODE" python3 "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_single_v5.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port "$HTTP" --cdp-port-base "$CDP"
  cat "$OUT/report.json"
  sleep 2
done
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
PROD_AFTER=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
test "$PROD_BEFORE" = "$PROD_AFTER"
echo PRODUCTION_CHROME_AFTER=$PROD_AFTER
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_VISIBLE_X11_GPU_SINGLE_CONDITIONS_EXACT_SHADOW_NO_LIVE_WRITE
echo '=== PASS ALL VISIBLE SINGLE CONDITIONS ==='
